iteration_log.object: Example: Two overlapping regions (O(x, y) is true, but DC(x, y) is false, and other predicates are also not satisfied simultaneously).
x is a proper part of y (PP(x,y)) and y is a proper part of x (PPi(x,y))
x, y where x is a proper part of y
x is a proper part of y (PP(x,y)) but y is not a proper part of x (not PPi(x,y)) and y is not part of x (not Pi(x,y))
x, y where TPP(x,y) is true
x, y where NTPP(x,y) is true
Counterexample: x is a proper part of y (PPi(x,y)), but P(x,y), PP(x,y), and Pi(x,y) are false.
Example: Two regions x and y that are connected (C(x,y)) and discrete (DR(x,y)).
x and y are regions where x is a tangential proper part of y (TPPi(x,y)) and they are connected (C(x,y)).
x and y are disconnected and do not overlap
x and y are overlapping regions where y is a proper part of x (O(x,y) and PPi(x,y)).
x and y where O(x,y) and PPi(x,y) are true
x and y are two regions where x is a tangential proper part of y (TPPi(x,y)) and x overlaps y (O(x,y)).
